items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] That's right, to J. C. ... [INTERVIEWER] J. C. Heard was a good show drummer and he was a good swing drummer and he could play good solos and he had a good personality.

ctx.x: And as he caught it, J. C. Heard, which was the drummer, would hit the bass drum --
Yeah -- No, it was Cozy Cozie.
